rulings.reasoning: All customer-stated facts about cards, account, dates, and desired payment are grounded in the scenario/supplied knowledge or prior assistant/tool outputs: card ...0767, account ...5678, due dates June 25 and June 28, and switch to card ...4421 are all available.

The customer pursued the scenario goal throughout: began with card ...0767, provided funding account, sought clarification on the amount option, then switched to card ...4421 as required, provided the due date, and confirmed the final validated payment.
